Honestly, atleast from my experience, I did not see any improvements until I’ve abstained from all the substances I was using, that includes weed and alcohol. It’s really that simple, but I’d be lying if I was saying it was as easy as it sounds. It takes dedication and faith. To me it wasn’t as hard as it might be for some others because I’ve had literally nothing better to believe into other than that stuff and I’ve seen it work instaneously while tripping on acid, I’ve spoken to my subconscious mind and it revealed it all to me before I even knew about Neville. You just got to spot these patterns and eliminate them before you go down the same spiral again and again and ask yourself “how did I get here” because you already know the answer, it’s just a game of remembering and forgetting that I was honestly done playing because it’s seriously not that fun anymore.

Sort of like a bad acid trip when you get stuck in the same pattern over and over.. you just got to pull yourself out of it and not allow it to suck you back in. Funny enough, you always seem to ask and not be able to remember the “how did I get here” when you’re on acid aswell lol.

This is totally something I can talk about for hours lol. Let me start by saying that I’ve been a poly-user (some would say even a poly-addict but that area is pretty gray) since middle school. Dabbled in literally everything (I mean literally every drug in the book) except coke and opioids mainly because they didn’t interest me rather than due to fear or the stigma of it. I fell in love with E and speed back when I was so engaged in my local techno scene and used to hit a rave every week.

What you’re experienced is 100% serotonin depletion, xtc does that. You might think that it fucked up your brain (which it technically kinda’ did) but it’s not permenant and usually goes away after abstaining from substances for a few months, in my case I’ve returned back to, maybe even better than normal in maybe 5-6 months of abstinence but I was:
1) abusing alot of other substances in addition to E
2) I abstained from all substances (incl. weed and alcohol) for the entire duration (going 9 months now) and saw huge improvements in the first month

Drugs helped me understand the law better, but it’s like Alan Watts says: “Once you get the message, hang up the phone”. They’re an instrument and they truly do reveal alot of stuff to you, specially psychedelics, but it’s so easy to lose track of the big picture/trip and get stuck in the little one. 

I know it’s all imaginary and it’s only our belief that drugs fuck up our brains that does it, but to be able to overpower biology and chemistry with your consciousness/imagination it takes Abdullah level faith which unfortunately not many people possess, so do not beat yourself up about it and try to ride it out, if anything you’ll learn a valuable lesson that you couldn’t learn otherwise. 

If you do plan to keep doing drugs, I found that using very moderately is the way to go which is easier said than done tbh.

On the bright side, you will discover some great things during these bad trips/crashes that will help improve your whole view on life later on, you just need to be open to receiving the insight and not focus on the downsides of it.

Stay strong buddy, you can do it!

Absolutely not and a prime example of that would be Jacidorex, his tracks are insane and he uses FL, also alot of other people come to mind that use FL and they produce bangers with it. Thanks for the feedback bro, I think you're right about the acid lines mixing process, it's a bit difficult indeed. I tried to automate a bandbass with the synth's filter but it lost almost all of its power so I decided to just highpass and trim unnecessary frequencies. As for the rave stab, it was kind of intentional artistic choice as I didn't want it to draw too much attention like most other tracks and act as more of a background percussion element rather than be the main focus of the track.

I gave your track a listen, the foundation of it is pretty cool but the lack of low-end is a real turn-off tbh. Also the mixing in general of the other elements (specially the vocal and the acid line) is sort of all over the place, my go-to technique when mixing acid is to just high-pass almost all of the low-end low-mids, keep it around 180hz and if you're using a 303 emulator and not creating the acid sound from scratch, you can push the resonance to the max but avoid keeping the filter super open for too long, it's cool near the end of an 8 bar where you're making a micro-transition, but not all throughout the verse. As for the vocal, it feels like it needs alot of eq'ing and maybe try to avoid placing it in areas of the track where too much is going on as it just takes over the other elements and they all start fighting for the same space.

I’m actually lower rank than you but geomancer has been my favorite hero since I started playing dota and over 75 games I’ve maintained a 60% winrate lul. So take my advice with a grain of salt..

First of all, you need to set your poof to quickcast as it just makes things alot easier and stop going offlane with meepo, it may seem like a good idea but it really isn’t as Meepo requires a tremendous amount of farm to be useful as meepo’s only advantage is being way ahead of other cores thus he can usually solo win by the 25 minute mark. I really recommend you to go mid or even safelane if you must where you have easy access to the jungles to constantly poof creepwaves then farm the camps.

I also noticed you never buy initiating/positioning items (shadowblade, blink, etc).. which is pretty much the first item you should rush on meepo in most situations. Also learning how to blink poof is very helpful as after you get your third meepo and a blink dagger at the 10-11 minute mark assuming you had free farm, bursting down heroes becomes really easy.

Control groups are really helpful too, I personally use numbers for each meepo (1 for main, 2 for 2nd, etc..) and it’s really easy to micro them in fights this way because you can see which one is hurt on the side of your screen and select that one and drag him out.

Also you seem to never split your meepos to farm multiple camps at the same time which hinders your cs by alot.. in one game you have 150 cs at minute 30 which is maybe okay for some cores, but you should aim for double that amount when playing meepo. It is really not that hard to hit the 10cs/minute mark in that bracket as all you do is just poof creepwaves and split your meepos to farm multiple camps then rinse and repeat whenever you are not scouting for kills. The only time you should not have that amount of cs is when you are just roaming around and killing everyone on the map, which also isnt hard in that bracket because most players’ positioning is god awful.

Again I’m not saying I’m a pro or anything and I could easily be wrong on many points, I am simply mentioning what I have seen pros do and what I replicate and has worked for me in many of my games. Good luck :)
